BackstoryDef.title: bunker initiate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up inside an underground Brotherhood bunker, memorizing codex chapters and disassembling laser rifles blindfolded before reaching adulthood.

BackstoryDef.title: Outcast protector
BackstoryDef.description: Disgusted when Elder Lyons prioritized local charity over seizing pre-war technology, [PAWN_nameDef] led a schism and forged the Brotherhood Outcasts. [PAWN_pronoun] refuses to spare even a hospital full of ghouls if its reactor can contain the Rift.

BackstoryDef.title: workshop apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood sorting pre-war servo motors and fusion cells in a cramped armory, developing an uncanny intuition for damaged power armor.

BackstoryDef.title: Outcast quartermaster
BackstoryDef.description: Following Casdin out of the Citadel, [PAWN_nameDef] became the backbone of Fort Independence, refurbishing blackened T-45d armor and extracting intact modules from collapsed pre-war archives.

BackstoryDef.title: archive copier
BackstoryDef.description: Too frail for heavy combat drills, young [PAWN_nameDef] transcribed pre-war schematics and decoded encrypted military holotapes in dim scriptorium halls.

BackstoryDef.title: conscience-stricken scribe
BackstoryDef.description: Assigned to catalog anomalies and power-armor blueprints for the Outcasts, [PAWN_nameDef] grew horrified by Casdin's plan to strip a working ghoul hospital of its reactor, secretly preparing to flee with the faction's prized schematics.

BackstoryDef.title: drill cadet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised on strict military discipline, excelling in marksmanship and tactical squad maneuvers from an early age.

BackstoryDef.title: iron-fisted defender
BackstoryDef.description: As Casdin's most ruthless field commander, [PAWN_nameDef] enforces absolute obedience among the Outcasts and stands ready to seize command and hunt down any defectors who betray the order.

BackstoryDef.title: wasteland foundry kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hauled scrap iron in a frontier smelter before being recruited into the Brotherhood for sheer physical endurance.

BackstoryDef.title: vanguard breacher
BackstoryDef.description: Clad in scarred black-and-red power armor, [PAWN_nameDef] leads Outcast breach teams into infested crypts and anomaly nests, deploying stasis traps to capture supernatural specimens.

BackstoryDef.title: ruin scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Orphaned on the edge of the Capital Wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to track mutant patrols and spot pre-war tech caches by moonlight.

BackstoryDef.title: tech-recovery scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ranges far ahead of Outcast strike squads, intercepting Gunner couriers and marking hidden pre-war reactors for immediate confiscation.
